messages.subject: consensus tree
parts: Can ggtree produce a consensus from multiple trees? Thanks.

messages.author: 65135aac151a06a7
messages.subject: Re: consensus tree
parts:
This can also be done easily in ape. https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ape/ape.pdf

library(ape)

tree1 <- read.tree(tree1file.tre)
tree2 <- read.tree(tree2file.tre)
.....

con_tree <- consensus(c(tree1,tree2,...)) #you can change the consensus level of support in this
